g.text: Comprehensive Specification of the 6 Functional & Governance Modules • Layered MVC with Flask Blueprints, Service Layer & SQLAlchemy ORM

text.tspan: identity verification, access controls, and academic

g.text: Secure student registration with institutional validation
Flask-Login session management with persistent cookies
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC: Student vs. Admin roles)

text.tspan: Structures technical and academic skill catalogs into
standardized disciplines with bilateral student intent

g.text: 8 pre-seeded MCA academic & technical subject categories
Case-insensitive skill deduplication on custom user input
Strict table constraint preventing duplicate user skill intents
Global searchable student directory with multi-criteria filters
Reciprocal Need-Offer matching (40% teach ∩ learn synergy)
Bonus points for category affinity (+10%) & proficiency (+10%)
Itemized compatibility breakdowns and strict self-exclusion

text.tspan: Orchestrates bilateral skill swap proposals, proposal
status transitions, and scheduled peer learning

g.text: Bilateral proposals with offered and requested skill bindings
Strict validation ensuring sender ≠ receiver (no self-swaps)
1-to-1 operational session booking for accepted proposals
Flexible session delivery modes: Online, In-Person, or Hybrid
Bilateral 1-to-5 star quantitative evaluations with CHECK bound
Qualitative testimonials & written peer learning remarks
Real-time computed student average ratings & review counts
Interactive student dashboard powered by Chart.js data feeds

text.tspan: charts, student fraud moderation with safe cascades,

g.text: Institutional dashboard with 4 live KPI cards & 3 Chart.js graphs
Student moderation & fraud account removal with safe cascading delete
Skill category & standard skill deletion with active swap guards
Search and query filtering across all enrolled student accounts
Protected by @admin_required RBAC & automated CLI management
Presentation (Jinja2 & Bootstrap 5) → Controller Tier (Flask Blueprints) → Business Tier (Service Layer) → Persistence Tier (SQLAlchemy 3NF on SQLite)
SkillConnect • MCA Semester 1 Mini Project • Lossless Technical Graphic
